title: Sheri Biggs Bank of Nova Scotia (BNS) Stock Purchase: $500K–$1M (Sep 2026)
content:
Rep. Sheri Biggs (SC-03) disclosed a purchase of $500,001–$1,000,000 of Bank of Nova Scotia (BNS) stock dated September 1, 2026.

Trade data: Bargo, compiled from U.S. House and Senate STOCK Act filings.

ItemDetail
MemberRep. Sheri Biggs, SC-03 (House)
SecurityBank of Nova Scotia (BNS)
Type / sizePurchase, $500,001–$1,000,000
Transaction dateSep 1, 2026
Disclosure dateSep 22, 2026 (21 days later)
Price$91.19 (Bargo estimate at purchase)

What's been disclosed

  • The purchase: A purchase of Bank of Nova Scotia stock worth $500,001–$1,000,000 on September 1, disclosed on September 22.
  • Size: This is one of the two largest reported ranges among the 100 most recent trade lines in the data we pulled (the other is a line in Rep. Kevin Hern's September 25 filing). 87 of the 100 lines were in the $1,001–$50,000 bands.
  • Price since: Bargo lists $91.19 as both the estimated price at purchase and the most recent price, so no price change is shown.

Quick FAQ

How long after the purchase was it disclosed?
21 days. The STOCK Act gives members 45 days from the transaction to disclose it.

Why is the amount a range?
Filings report value bands such as $500,001–$1,000,000 instead of exact dollar amounts.

What is BNS?
BNS is the ticker for Bank of Nova Scotia (Scotiabank), a Canadian bank whose shares trade on the New York Stock Exchange.

Why does the price show no change?
Bargo's price fields for this trade are identical ($91.19 for both dates), so no price comparison is available.
